Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

GICHighDimension (development version)

Speed

  • The selection search no longer forms the n x n hat matrix. Every criterion is computed from X’Y and (X’X)^{-1}, and each add/remove move is scored with a rank-one update, at O(nK + K^2) cost. On simulated data this is 38-371 times faster than 0.1.2 and selects the same variables at every step.
  • EBIC computes log(choose(P, K)) in floating point instead of with big integers.
  • The Julia code is loaded once per session instead of on every call.

New features

  • New article, vignette("examples"): worked simulations for a linear model with 500 predictors, a multivariate-normal response, and Poisson, binomial and multinomial GLMs, each comparing AIC, BIC, GIC5 and GIC6.
  • LP_to_Y(), Y_to_LP() and Beta_estimate() support Normal, Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson, Gamma, Exponential, InverseGaussian, NegativeBinomial, Geometric, MultivariateNormal and Multinomial responses.
  • GICSelection() and GICSelectionBoltzmann() gain a gamma argument for EBIC (default 0.6); GICSelectionBoltzmann() gains an optional k.
  • citation("GICHighDimension") cites Xiao and Walker (2026), Statistics and Computing doi:10.1007/s11222-026-10853-5.
  • A pkgdown website.

Bug fixes and behaviour changes

  • Models never exceed n - 1 variables (n = sample size), so the search no longer produces a singular fit when p > n.
  • GICSelectionBoltzmann() works with criteria that use P (GIC2-GIC6, EBIC) and no longer calls Pkg.add() when loaded.
  • Calculate_EBIC() and Calculate_EBIC_short() use the same gamma (they used 0.6 and 1).
  • GICSelection() stops with an error instead of returning NA with a warning, and selected_coeffs is a plain R list.
  • LP_to_Y() with family = "Gamma" has mean exp(eta) for every shape (before, the mean was shape * exp(eta)); univariate families return a vector.
  • Beta_estimate() uses the log link by default for Gamma (as LP_to_Y() does), treats integer counts as Poisson when family = "auto", and fits Binomial counts as proportions with n_trials weights.

GICHighDimension 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN release.
  • Added GIC-based variable selection using Boltzmann and Hopfield optimization strategies.
  • Includes interfaces to fast Julia implementations of AIC, AICc, BIC (SIC), CAIC, CAICF, and GIC2–GIC6.
  • Provides utility functions for data generation and coefficient vector construction.
  • Vignette demonstrates usage and model selection workflows.
